string.text: Light, foliage, fog, wind, wetness and snowfall follow the real-world date, mapped to Polesia's five seasons. These change in-engine, immediately. Terrain and grass TEXTURES cannot - the engine binds them at load - so they are swapped at launch and need a restart.
Turning this off releases control at once. Values already applied are left as they are, not reset.

Automatic follows today's real date. The named seasons pin one in place and ignore the calendar. NOTE: pinning changes light, fog, wind, wetness and snowfall at once, but NOT terrain textures - those are chosen at launch. To move the ground too, pick the season, exit, and start the game with play.bat.
How long one season takes to become the next. The window is centered on the changeover date, so 14 eases the shift in across the week either side. 0 is a hard switch.
How far to push toward the season. 100% is the full look, 0% the neutral baseline this install ships with.
Grading, saturation, exposure, sun and sky brightness, tonemapping, sunshafts. Off if you would rather use cfg_load.
Grass and tree specular, and sunlight scattering through a leaf - high on thin spring growth, near zero on bare winter branches.
Fog height, density, sun coloring and scattering. Autumn is the foggy season here; summer the clearest.
How grass and trees move. Spring is the windiest, summer the stillest, and winter branches are stiff rather than limp.

How fast surfaces take on water and how fast they dry. Spring stays wet from the thaw; summer dries quickly, so it is wet only while it rains. Puddle shape itself is baked into the shaders and cannot follow the season.
Mod list unavailable - launch with play.bat and it will be built.

Master switch for the launch-time layer. Off means no seasonal texture mod is ever mounted, whatever the date, and the Zone keeps the terrain it has now. Light, color, foliage, fog, wind, wetness and snowfall carry on following the calendar either way. Takes effect on the next launch.

Silences sound channels that do not belong to the season - insects under snow, marsh life in a frozen swamp. Spring and summer keep everything; autumn drops swamp life; winter silences all insects; deep winter also silences daytime birds. Crows and owls are kept year-round on purpose. Wind, storms and interiors are never touched. Off means the soundscape plays unchanged all year. Takes effect on the next launch.
Show a short message on screen when the season shifts during play.
Once you are in the world, your PDA reports the real date, the season it selects, and how long until the next turns.
How long after loading the report arrives. Too short and it is buried by the loading screen before you see it.
Season calendar unavailable - the main script did not load.
